Retrieve the skey  for the specified integration. Requires "Grant applications" API
permission. Does not work for SSO integrations.
This endpoint does not use the same authentication and request signing detailed earlier
in this document. Our Python, Go, Java, and Node.JS API clients have been updated
with the new authentication and signing requirements and include support for this
endpoint operation. We recommend you use the duo_client_python Python API client,
the duo_api_golang Go API client, the duo_client_java Java API client, or the
duo_api_nodejs Node.JS API client to perform this operation.
